transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. It's very nice to meet you, too. Thank you so much for fitting me in. 

Um... I'm not entirely sure where to start, to be honest. I hope I'm explaining this right. I just... well, I've been under a bit of stress at work—I'm a translator—and I just wanted to make sure I'm handling things appropriately. Does that make sense? 

The thing is, for a few months now, I've been noticing... well, a sort of pattern in our project files. I hate to complain about my team, I really do, but it seems like certain subcontractors and... and one colleague in particular, keep making these tiny little changes to the translation memory. And the timestamps, too. It's set up so it looks like my quality control failed. 

I know how that sounds, and I really don't want to seem like a difficult employee who's just pointing fingers... but even when IT checked and said the audit trail is completely clean, I... I just know the record has been arranged to put the blame on me. I hope I don't sound unreasonable saying that? I just want to do a good job and make sure I'm seeing things clearly.
Have you noticed any other unusual experiences, such as hearing voices or sounds that others don't seem to hear?

Oh, no, no, nothing like that at all. I mean, I know sometimes stress can do funny things to people, but I definitely haven't heard any voices or sounds or anything out of the ordinary like that. 

My hearing is perfectly fine, and my mind is clear. I hope you don't think I'm... you know, losing touch with reality or anything? It's really just this very specific issue with the files at work. Everything else is completely normal, I promise. I just want to figure out how to handle this situation at the office without causing a fuss. That's reasonable, right?
Are you currently taking any prescription medications, or have you recently had any significant changes in your physical health or medical history?

Oh, no, I'm not taking any prescription medications at all. I try to stay as healthy as I can—you know, eating right and getting enough sleep—so I haven't needed to take anything. I hope that's a good thing? 

And as for my physical health... no, no significant changes or anything like that. I'm actually in pretty good shape, I think. My last checkup with my regular doctor was completely fine. I really try to take good care of myself so I can stay focused on my work and be reliable. That's the right approach, isn't it? I just want to make sure I'm doing everything I'm supposed to.
Do you feel that anyone outside of your workplace, such as friends, family members, or people you encounter in public, is also involved in this situation or trying to interfere with you in any way?

Oh, goodness, no. No, it's nothing like that. It's strictly just... just an office issue. My family and friends are wonderful, they really are. I wouldn't want you to think I'm paranoid about people in general or... or that I'm suspicious of strangers on the street. That would be awful, wouldn't it? 

I keep my work life and my personal life very separate. My friends don't know anything about translation memory software or timestamps anyway, so they couldn't possibly be involved, even if they wanted to be. Which they don't, of course! Everyone outside of work is perfectly lovely. It's really just this one very specific, isolated problem with those project files at the office. I hope I'm being clear that I don't have any issues with anyone else? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture.
Why do you think your colleague is going to the trouble of altering these files to make it look like your quality control failed?

Well... I, um... I hate to even speculate, to be honest. I really try to be a good team player, so talking about this feels a little... uncomfortable. I don't want you to think I'm just pointing fingers or being a difficult employee. I hope I don't come across that way? 

It’s just that... for months now, I’ve been seeing this exact same pattern in the project files. It’s... well, it's certain subcontractors and this one particular colleague. They keep making these tiny, tiny changes to the translation memory and the timestamps. It's so subtle, but the end result is that it makes it look exactly like my quality control failed. 

I even asked IT to look into it—very politely, I promise, I didn't demand anything or make a scene! But they told me the audit trail is completely clean. I didn't argue with them, of course... but, well, I just know the record has been arranged somehow to put the blame on me. Maybe they're just trying to cover up their own errors so they don't get in trouble? I'm really not sure. I just want to protect my professional reputation. That's a normal thing to be concerned about, right? I'm just trying to do my job the best I can.
How long have you been noticing this specific pattern of changes in the project files?

Well, um, let's see... I think it's been about, oh, maybe 11 months now? Yes, that sounds right. It started just a little while after I was put in charge of the new localization project. 

I really tried to ignore it at first, you know? I didn't want to make a fuss or seem like I couldn't handle the new responsibility. I kept thinking, 'Oh, it's just a glitch, or maybe I'm misreading the timestamps.' I always try to give people the benefit of the doubt. But it just kept happening, very consistently, over these past 11 months. 

I hope it doesn't sound like I'm holding a grudge or keeping track for too long? I really just wanted to be absolutely sure before I started worrying about it. It takes a while to be certain about these technical things, doesn't it? I just want to make sure I'm doing a good job with the project I was trusted with.
How has this ongoing situation at work affected your ability to sleep, eat, or complete your daily tasks outside of the office?

Oh, well... honestly, my life outside of that one specific issue is completely normal. I really hope you don't think I'm falling apart or anything like that! I'm actually doing quite well overall. 

My sleep and appetite are just fine, really. I still do all my regular translation work, I manage my team's workflow without any problems, I pay my bills on time... I'm very responsible about all of that. And my family routines haven't changed a bit. I make sure to be present for them. 

It's truly just... well, the only time things feel a little stressful or off track is when I have to deal with the file history or when those specific coworkers come up. But other than that, I'm functioning perfectly fine. I manage everything else just like anyone else would. That's a good sign, isn't it? That I'm keeping everything else running smoothly?
Are there any other beliefs or convictions you hold that your friends or family have disagreed with or told you were not true?

Oh, no, definitely not. I mean, my family and I get along really well, and we don't really argue about things like that. I try to be very easygoing at home. I don't want to bring work stress into the house, you know? 

I really don't have any strange ideas or, um, unusual beliefs, I promise. It's truly just this one very specific, very real issue at work with the files. Everything else in my life is completely ordinary. I hope that makes sense? I'm just a normal guy trying to do a good job and take care of my family. I don't want to sound like someone who goes around making up wild stories.
